items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1993-05-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] So, when you're at... Was Mr. Valentino at Warren Easton then? No. [INTERVIEWEE] When you were at Warren Easton? No.

ctx.x: They would literally turn around. They'd belly up. Right. So, then they started making them that they, one side was very slick and the opposite side had more friction. And they would tend to go along and flip over easier one way than another. Or that they were geometrically imperfect. They weren't perfect cubes. Okay. And things like that. So, I learned all about things like that and how cards were marked and all that. But it was because the gambling houses had to protect themselves from the clientele. Most…
